title: Computing Weighted Set Covers with Heterogeneous Stochastic Oracles: Deadline-Constrained Token Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2611.26656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study computation in which a probabilistic Turing machine (PTM) uses AI systems, abstracted as heterogeneous stochastic oracles (HSOs), to solve Weighted Set Cover. A pilot study shows that an LLM can outperform weighted greedy. HSOs differ in capabilities, response distributions, latencies, and token costs. We study how the PTM selects HSOs to obtain, by a deadline and with a required success probability, a full cover satisfying a prescribed weight threshold, and we analyze expected token cost.   For queries requesting full covers, assuming independent call successes and uninformative failures, we characterize by linear programming the minimum expected token cost for every feasible success probability. An optimal policy randomizes over at most two preselected sequences of oracle batches. translated_title: 利用异构随机预言机计算加权集合覆盖：截止期限约束下的令牌复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一种计算模式，其中概率图灵机（PTM）利用被抽象为异构随机预言机的AI系统来求解加权集合覆盖问题。一项初步研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）的表现可以优于加权贪心算法。异构随机预言机在能力、响应分布、延迟和令牌成本方面各不相同。我们研究了PTM如何选择HSO，以便在截止期限内、以所需的成功概率获得满足规定权重阈值的完整覆盖，并分析期望令牌成本。对于请求完整覆盖的查询，在假设各次调用成功相互独立且失败不提供信息的前提下，我们通过线性规划刻画了每个可行成功概率对应的最小期望令牌成本。最优策略在至多两个预先选择的预言机批次序列上进行随机化。在达到最大成功概率的策略中，相对于一次性查询所有预言机，两批次选择所实现的期望成本降低……
tldr: 该论文刻画了概率图灵机在截止期限和成功概率约束下求解加权集合覆盖问题的最小期望令牌成本，证明最优策略至多需要在两个预选的预言机批次序列之间随机化。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the minimum expected token cost for a probabilistic Turing machine to solve Weighted Set Cover under deadline and success-probability constraints using heterogeneous stochastic oracles, showing that an optimal policy randomizes over at most two preselected sequences of oracle batches.
